privacy.notes: The public agent layer logs event type, path, method, user agent, Cloudflare country/colo when available, and tool/resource names. It does not log inquiry body content or private credentials.

recommendedQueries: Filter logs where service is desertscape-form-worker or desertscape-mcp-worker.
Group by event to compare llms.txt reads, OpenAPI reads, MCP requests, and MCP tool calls.
Group by userAgent to identify Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and other AI/search crawlers.
Group by country to identify international agent or search interest.
Inspect mcp_tool_call events for match_desertscape_project_scope, match_project_scope, prepare_desertscape_project_inquiry, and prepare_project_inquiry.

nextUpgrade.name: Cloudflare Analytics Engine or Logpush dashboard
nextUpgrade.requires: A dedicated analytics binding or Logpush destination approved in Cloudflare.
nextUpgrade.reason: Worker logs are enough for monitoring and debugging. A true aggregate dashboard needs a durable analytics sink.
